div.head: Mirce 4
div.ab: Se wer gebyreð magum 7 seo cynebot þam leodum.
Ipsam weram debent habere parentes eius et regalem emendationem ipsius terrę populus.
Se wer gebirað magum 7 seo cynebot þam leodum.
Se wer gebyreð magum and seo cynebot þam leodum.
Das Wergeld gebührt den Verwandten (erhalten die Verw. lq) und die Königsbusse dem Volke (des Landes lq).
The wergild belongs to the kinsmen (the kinsmen receive, lq) and the king-compensation to the people (of the land, lq).
The wergild belongs to the kinsmen and the royal-compensation to the people.
The wergild belongs to his kinsmen and the royal compensation to the people.
div.note: In H, EGu follows after a paragraph break; in D and O, Að. Liebermann compares Norðleod 1.
